sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Competitive Gaming Matchmaking and Tournament Systems

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (common law modeled on United States and Delaware corporate law, with local statutory codification and customary law retained where not inconsistent)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (economic relations and investment access provisions; not a bilateral investment treaty)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (Marshall Islands effective WTO member since 18 May 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporation Act (BCA), as amended, forming part of the Associations Law of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Title 50, Chapter 1 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2014 (as amended); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2014; Beneficial Ownership (Information) Regulations issued by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime (Amendment) Act, as amended; and APG/FATF standards as adopted in RMI domestic directives.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder or UBO entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies in the shareholder's country of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association / constitutional charter of each corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of the corporate entity's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (if country is not an Apostille contracting state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passports of all directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing state or recognized notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and proof of residential address (dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy by notary; no apostille required for internal AML file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership register extract / UBO questionnaire and declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: RMI registered agent or home-country FIU/company registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized and apostilled if obtained outside the Marshall Islands

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders and UBOs against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, UK OFSI Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and RMI domestic sanctions notices. PEP screening is mandatory; PEPs and family/close associates require enhanced due diligence, documented source of wealth and funds, and senior-management approval before incorporating.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations – Corporate Name Search and Reservation System, filed electronically through licensed RMI registered agents (administered by International Registries, Inc. on behalf of the Registrar of Corporations)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official filing language is English. Names must be in Latin script and must be distinguishable on the registry from existing/prior reserved names. Transliterated English-only names are required where the operating brand is in a non-Latin alphabet; the name must not be obscene, misleading, or imply a relationship with the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands unless duly authorized.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On a rejection, the applicant or its licensed RMI registered agent files a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the refusal, stating the distinguishing characteristics, proposed transliteration, and any consent from a regulator if a sensitive token is used. The Registrar shall issue a reasoned written decision within 14 business days; a further appeal lies to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands under the RMI Administrative Procedure Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are permissible for this non-resident Business Corporation. The statutory registered office must be a physical address in Majuro or Ebeye maintained by the RMI licensed registered agent; service of process and regulator correspondence can be directed to that address while the esports platform operates remotely.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated at 5-10% over the first operating year. Because ISIC 5820 software publishing/esports platform is a low-risk category without local premises, unannounced inspections are unlikely; the dominant compliance touchpoint will be the registered agent's annual AML/CFT audit and regulatory file inspection.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act (BCA), Republic of the Marshall Islands, as amended (RMI Code Title 24), Sections 13, 14, 45, 54, and 87
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, acting through a licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required; shares may be issued for money, property, or services as determined by the board. No escrowed capital deposit or local Marshall Islands bank account is required for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that this Corporation accept the subscription of [Initial Shareholder] for one hundred (100) common shares at a subscription price of $1.00 per share, with payment to be received before issuance; RESOLVED, that the registered office located at [Registered Agent Address], Majuro, Marshall Islands, and the registered agent [Registered Agent Name] are approved and appointed as the registered office and registered agent; RESOLVED, that [O1] is appointed Chief Executive Officer, [O2] is appointed Secretary, and [O3] is appointed Treasurer, with full authority to execute documents, sign checks, and open bank accounts; RESOLVED, that the officers are authorized to complete all post-incorporation filings, including annual reports and tax registration, as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registry information service through an RMI licensed registered agent; no direct public online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search request to the registered agent with the proposed corporate name. The agent verifies availability against the Registrar's corporate index and files a name reservation request if the name is available. The reservation is effective for thirty days, sufficient to complete the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Identification of proposed entity type and jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is unavailable or confusingly similar, select an alternate name and re-file the reservation; no penalty is incurred for changing the reservation request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Registered Agent and Establish Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands; Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent appointment agreement confirming the registered agent's consent to act and confirming the physical registered office street address in Majuro. Provide the agent with the corporation's principal contact details and final governing documents for service of process and statutory correspondence.
required_dossiers: Corporate information sheet with directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed registered office address is rejected or deemed incomplete, obtain a corrected address confirmation from the registered agent and amend the consent form before incorporation filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate counsel or incorporator; no filing with the Registrar at this step
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation including the corporate name, registered agent, registered office, purpose clause, authorized share structure, and any preferred or convertible share provisions. Prepare the Bylaws to govern shareholder meetings, director elections, officer roles, indemnification, and record-keeping.
required_dossiers: Shareholder consent to authorized share structure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar later identifies drafting defects, amend the Articles before filing or prepare a corrected draft and resubmit with the required execution pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute and File Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands, through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Sign the Articles of Incorporation before a notary or by an authorized corporate officer. Pay the statutory filing fee of $200 to the Registrar via the licensed agent and submit the signed Articles for filing. The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon acceptance of the Articles.
required_dossiers: Signed and notarized Articles of Incorporation
Registered agent consent and address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns a query or rejection, correct the cited deficiency and resubmit within the stated cure period; coordinate with the registered agent for expedited resubmission and pay any additional resubmission fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appoint Initial Directors, Subscribe Shares, and Adopt First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and initial directors under the Business Corporations Act; corporate records maintained internally
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, the incorporator appoints the initial directors. The initial shareholder subscribes to the authorized common shares, and the board adopts the First Board Resolution approving the share subscription, registered office, registered agent, and officer appointments. Maintain all documents in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: First written consent of directors or board meeting minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any consent or subscription document is incomplete, re-execute the relevant instrument and correct the corporate records; no Registrar filing is required unless the amendment implicates the Articles of Incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Annual Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations; corporate secretary/tax compliance officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate minute book and stock ledger, keep minutes of the First Board Resolution, and file the first annual report if due within the current registration period. Confirm whether a non-resident business corporation tax exemption election or zero-income declaration is required, and maintain the registered agent and office in good standing.
required_dossiers: Annual report filing form, if due
Corporate records book with stock ledger
Board meeting minutes and officer consents
Tax status election or exemption declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual report is submitted late, pay the statutory late penalty and file immediately with the Registrar; correct any outdated officer, agent, or address information by filing an amendment or change notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable — no physical industrial establishment is contemplated for this non-resident esports community platform. The RMI Business Corporation will not maintain a factory, warehouse, or retail office. The Foreign Investment Business License requirement does not apply where no business is transacted within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable — no statutory operating or manufacturing permit is triggered under ISIC 5820 for an online competitive-gaming matchmaking and tournament platform. If a physical office is later established, a local business license from the Majuro municipal authority would be required.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III — Exempt from Environmental Impact Assessment; the platform is a pure digital service with no construction, land disturbance, wastewater generation, or combustion emissions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge or emission thresholds apply. If a physical office is established, RMIEPA standards for domestic wastewater and solid-waste segregation must be met; no VOC or industrial wastewater limits are triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required in the initial formation because the corporation will have no physical workspace. If a Majuro office or venue is later established, obtain a Fire Safety Certificate from the Majuro Fire Department, a structural load inspection and building occupancy permit from the Majuro municipality, and an occupational safety clearance for any local employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Tax and Revenue Office, Ministry of Finance (administrative paper-based process; no public e-filing portal)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation with no Marshall Islands-source business activity is not required to obtain a tax identification number. Should the entity derive gross revenue from sources within the Republic, it must submit a Business License Application (Form BL-1) to the Tax and Revenue Office along with the Certificate of Incorporation, registered agent details, and the applicable annual business license fee. Upon approval, the Office issues a Business License Number which also serves as the taxpayer identification number. Foreign entities may not self-register online; filings are processed through a licensed registered agent in Majuro.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Marshall Islands law. An eligible non-resident Business Corporation may apply for an 'Exempt Company Certificate' under Part X of the Business Corporation Act, which confirms the entity's exemption from Marshall Islands income tax and effectively operates as the sole statutory classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None – no value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or sales and use tax is imposed in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; no indirect tax registration threshold exists. Official currency is the United States Dollar (USD). The only recurring charge is an annual Business License Fee based on business classification, generally ranging from USD 50 to USD 1,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands does not mandate electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API-based reporting, or digital stamping for indirect tax purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: No VAT/GST system is in force, so there is no export zero-rating claim mechanism. Cross-border digital services (esports platform operations, matchmaking, tournament administration) are outside the scope of Marshall Islands income taxation for non-resident corporations and do not give rise to any indirect tax liability.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: None required for Marshall Islands indirect tax purposes; RMI Customs may require a Customs Export Declaration only for physical goods exported from the Republic.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable; there is no indirect tax regime, and therefore no VAT-related clawback or penalty can arise. Misrepresentation in an application for Exempt Company Certificate status may result in revocation of that certificate, reinstatement of income tax liability for prior periods, and administrative fines not exceeding USD 1,000 under the Business Corporation Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank is established in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); banking and foreign-exchange-license supervision is conducted by the Office of the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, with United States dollar as the sole legal tender and de facto monetary policy anchored to the U.S. Federal Reserve.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. dollar is legal tender and the RMI maintains no domestic currency, making current and capital account transactions freely convertible in law. There are no exchange-control decrees, no revenue repatriation restrictions, and no approval requirement for the remittance of profit, dividends, liquidating proceeds, or invested capital. Remaining frictions are not FX-control related but rather arise from bank-level AML/CFT due diligence, FATCA/CRS reporting, and correspondent-bank expectations; an esports platform can hold, convert, and remit funds globally without prior official approval from the RMI Government.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The RMI imposes no statutory timelines, mandatory conversion ratios, or surrender requirements on export proceeds. Because the esports platform's receipts are non-tangible exports (matchmaking fees, tournament entry fees, sponsorship and in-platform digital goods), all receipts in USD or other convertible currencies may be retained freely, net of service fees paid to payment processors such as Stripe and PayPal, without reference to any RMI central bank or FX-administered quota.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam - Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High feasibility. Digital cross-border EMI providers such as Wise Business, Airwallex, Mercury, and Payoneer will generally accept an RMI non-resident Business Corporation when the commercial description unmistakably reflects 'software platform for competitive gaming matchmaking and tournament management' rather than prohibited gambling. Legal constraints are limited: the RMI does not license or regulate EMIs, so the platform must rely on the EMI's underlying bank partners and ensure the EMI's user terms permit USD clearing for an exempt RMI entity. Offline-only domestic banks remain conservative and may be slower to approve the structure, while top-tier EMIs are the strategic liquidity gateway for Stripe and PayPal settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No RMI statute requires directors to appear physically at any banking office. For local banks, remote opening may be approved after delivery of apostilled/notarized corporate documents, certified passport copies, and a registered-agent declaration, but in practice a mandatory video-conference interview is required and some U.S.-correspondent banks may request an in-person meeting in Guam or Hawaii. Offshore EMIs are fully remote, with digital identity verification and no physical-presence requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived tax-haven structure: RMI exempt corporation with non-resident shareholders and no domestic corporate tax profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a current Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar, the registered-agent Due Diligence Certificate, the complete shareholder/UBO register, IRS/CRS classification forms (including IRS W-8BEN-E/EIN records), a business plan evidencing active software licensing and global user operations, and an independent legal opinion under the RMI Business Corporations Act and U.S. tax principles confirming a non-passive commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Esports tournament entry fees and cash prizes that may be misclassified as unlawful online gambling or money transmission.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver a formal compliance pack containing the platform's skill-based competition rules, prize-fund escrow agreement, independent audit certificate for tournament randomness and scoring, no-wagering policy, screenshot of Stripe/PayPal non-gaming category labeling, AML/CFT transaction monitoring policies, and an interpretation note from U.S. gaming counsel demonstrating that skills-based esports payouts do not constitute sports betting or lottery.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of first capital injection and suspicious inter-company funding from multiple jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble a source-of-funds robust file: original audited bank statements of the shareholder, share-subscription certificate, board resolution authorizing the funding, route explanation for each MT103, UBO passport and proof-of-address, and a sworn declaration of legitimate source of wealth. Include tax-transparency forms to prevent silent-partner or bearer-share suspicion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency cross-border payouts to international individual tournament winners in sanction-sensitive regions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Demonstrate institutional-grade controls: OFAC/UN/UK HMT sanctions screening integrated into player onboarding, IP-based geo-blocking of prohibited jurisdictions, transaction analytics with per-account velocity thresholds, segregation of sponsor funds from prize pools, a perpetual KYC review schedule for prize recipients, and a monthly independent anti-money-laundering testing report.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital via SWIFT MT103 from the originator's home bank into the RMI entity's settlement account held with a U.S. or international correspondent bank. No RMI exchange-control approval is required. Best practice is to include in the MT103 a purpose payment code described as 'Equity subscription to MH Business Corporation MH_BC' plus the RMI corporate registry number. The originator must pass the U.S. beneficial-ownership certification (31 CFR 1010.230) if the shareholder holds 25% or more. Back-to-back KYC documentation should be pre-cleared with the receiving bank before the wire; funds should be received into a capital escrow account first and only transferred to operational accounts upon board resolution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For cloud hosting, software licensing, developer contracts, and marketing services, clear SWIFT MT103 instructions from the operational account to the supplier's bank. For tournament prize payouts, use either the bank's batched MT103 interface or Stripe Connect / PayPal Payouts for sub-$100 micro-disbursements, ensuring the recipient's identity and age are verified. Commercial letters of credit (MT700) may be used for large hardware purchase orders, but for a digital-only platform, the primary clearing rails are SWIFT/Fedwire/ACH and processor-permitted card networks; master account segregation between sponsor income and prize pool reserves is required to satisfy audit trails and AML trust safeguards.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/EUR forward contracts with a level-1 licensed international bank to hedge tournament entry fees and sponsor receipts in euro
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/INR and USD/IDR to hedge sponsor collections from capital-controlled jurisdictions, with settlement in USD through an offshore dealing desk
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD/EUR) for long-term global sponsorship contracts of multi-year duration, fixing the USD/EUR conversion rate and swap-linked funding costs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee and Annual Report Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the company's anniversary date of incorporation in each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of 20% of the unpaid annual fee (minimum US$50); failure to file for one consecutive year triggers administrative strike-off; continued default leads to dissolution by the Registrar after 90 days' notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit not mandatory for a non-resident private business corporation; audit is required only if the entity is a public company or if the board / shareholders resolve to conduct an independent audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP at the company's election; Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act requires books of account sufficient to explain transactions and present true and fair financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the company must confirm its register of members and beneficial owners with the registered agent; any shareholding transfer occurring during the year must be documented in the share ledger, and the updated UBO return must be filed with the Registrar of Corporations within 30 days after the change or annual confirmation deadline.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Business Corporations Act 1991, Part XIII, Section 14 exempts qualifying non-resident domestic corporations from all income taxes; Income Tax Act 1989 imposes no tax on foreign-source income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory zero-tax regime on foreign-source income; no capital gains tax, no sales tax or VAT, no payroll tax, no estate duty, and no stamp duty. The sole fiscal impositions are the annual corporate registration/franchise tax (USD 50–USD 350 based on authorized share capital, maximum statutory cap USD 500) and the 3% Gross Revenue Tax (Income Tax Act 1989, Section 9) levied only on gross revenue derived from sources within the Marshall Islands, capped at USD 500,000 per annum. A non-resident esports platform with no RMI-source activity pays no effective corporate income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Annual Report / Annual Certificate — Business Corporations Act 1991, Section 107; filed through the Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations E-Filing Portal (electronic) or by paper submission to the Office of the Registrar, Majuro.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing window opens 30 days before the anniversary of incorporation and closes 90 days after the anniversary date; late fees accrue after the close of the window. Recommended filing before the anniversary to avoid penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name and registration number as recorded at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; do not use trade names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office physical address within the Marshall Islands (P.O. Box permitted as mailing address; street address required).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the RMI address maintained by the registered agent; foreign address not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name, address, and license number; must be an entity licensed in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations must appoint and maintain a licensed RMI registered agent at all times.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, number of shares, and par value; drives the annual franchise tax computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the same authorized capital stated in the Articles of Incorporation; undercapitalized declarations may trigger reclassification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full names, residential addresses, and nationalities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; no residency requirement for directors under RMI law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Nature of business / concise description of the principal activities conducted and whether any revenue is sourced within the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe 'global esports tournament matchmaking and community platform'; state 'no RMI-source gross revenue' as applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature certification by an authorized director, officer, or the registered agent; electronically authenticated filings accepted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The certificate must be executed under oath or affirmation; knowingly false filings expose the signatory to personal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of USD 25 per month or partial month, escalating to USD 100 per month after 90 days; non-filing for six consecutive months triggers administrative dissolution under BCA Section 110; reinstatement requires payment of all arrearages, an additional reinstatement fee, and a 10% surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Revenue Tax Return — Income Tax Act 1989, Section 9 (3% Gross Revenue Tax); administered by the RMI Ministry of Finance & Administration, Tax Division; quarterly electronic or paper filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly return due on the last day of the month following the close of each calendar quarter; annual reconciliation, if applicable, due by 30 April following the tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands, including payments for services performed, licenses used, or property situated in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident esports platform, exclude all global tournament fees, subscriptions, and sponsorships earned outside the RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source revenue exclusion: revenue earned from sales, services, or activities performed entirely outside the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a one-page jurisdictional revenue schedule showing zero or minimal RMI-source amounts to evidence the exclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemptions and deductions under the Income Tax Act (e.g., exemptions for shipping, government contracts, or treaty-type carve-outs).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only RMI-law exemptions apply; no treaty reduction is available given the absence of an RMI tax treaty network.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable gross revenue = Line 1 minus Lines 2 and 3.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be zero if the platform has no RMI-source activity; retain underlying payment-provider transaction reports as backup.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue Tax due at 3% of taxable gross revenue, subject to the USD 500,000 annual statutory cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If Line 4 is zero, enter zero; no minimum filing fee applies for a zero return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly remittance amount and declaration of truthfulness under civil and criminal penalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations with zero RMI-source revenue may submit a one-page declaration indicating 'NIL return — no RMI-source gross revenue.'

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% per month of the unpaid tax, capped at 25%; late payment interest accrues at 18% per annum; willful non-remittance or fraudulent declaration carries a criminal fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years under the Income Tax Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or liquidation proceeds paid by a domestic business corporation to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; therefore no treaty relief protocol exists for RMI-source income. A foreign parent may request a Certificate of Residence (Tax Residency Certificate) from the RMI Ministry of Finance & Administration to support foreign tax credit claims abroad; the certificate is issued upon written application with evidence of the corporation's registered agent, registered office, annual return filings, and bank account presence. No reduced-withholding procedure is applicable in the RMI because the statutory rate is already zero.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on royalties, license fees, and debt interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rates: not applicable (no DTA network). The 3% domestic Gross Revenue Tax may apply only where the licensing or financing activity constitutes a taxable presence or source within the RMI, which normally does not occur under a pure non-resident esports platform structure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable in USD — the Marshall Islands has not enacted mandatory Local File or Master File transfer pricing documentation rules. Voluntary OECD-aligned transfer pricing documentation is recommended for any RMI entity belonging to a multinational enterprise group with consolidated revenue exceeding EUR 750 million, given the RMI's commitment to the OECD Inclusive Framework / Global Minimum Tax (Pillar Two) and the expected enactment of a Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax (QDMTT).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations comparable to BVI/Cayman ESR; however, OECD Inclusive Framework membership and the Global Minimum Tax framework require genuine economic substance for entities claiming zero-tax status. For an esports platform, the registered agent, local directors, decision-making records, board minutes, and an operating bank account must be demonstrably maintained, and the platform's IP, contracting staff, and tournament operations should not be artificially relocated merely to avoid foreign tax. Banks and payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) will independently apply economic substance and AML due diligence and may terminate the merchant account without warning if substance is not verifiable.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely declaring the esports platform to be fully non-resident and tax-exempt while in fact operating tournament servers, employing staff, or deriving gross revenue from sources physically located in the Marshall Islands; failing to file the 3% Gross Revenue Tax return on RMI-source receipts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of the full 3% gross revenue tax on all RMI-source revenue; statutory interest at 18% per annum; civil penalty of up to 10% of the tax deficiency; criminal conviction for willful evasion carries a fine of up to USD 10,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the tax deficiency; RMI courts may pierce the corporate veil upon a finding of alter ego or fraud, ordering civil restitution, asset freezes, and a court-imposed bar on leaving the jurisdiction pending settlement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging entry fees for esports tournaments and awarding cash, skins, or tokenized prizes where the outcome is determined wholly or partly by chance, without an RMI lottery or gaming authorization; operating player-versus-player wagering or 'pick-em' contests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of tournament proceeds; a criminal fine of up to USD 25,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years under the RMI Penal Code gambling provisions; gaming contracts and prize payouts may be declared void and unenforceable.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: All directors engaged in the operation are criminally liable as principals; the corporate veil is disregarded to prevent limited liability from shielding individual operators; restitution to losing participants may be ordered against directors personally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a no-substance shelf entity (no physical office, no employees, no locally convened board meetings, no decision-making, no bank account) and routing esports platform revenues through the RMI solely to obtain zero-tax treatment and frustrate foreign revenue authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: At the domestic level, the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation for non-filing and impose reinstatement penalties; at the international level, OECD Inclusive Framework rules, if applicable, subject the group to a 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax (QDMTT) as RMI implementing legislation advances; foreign jurisdictions may deny treaty benefits and impose secondary adjustments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign courts and tax authorities may recharacterize the RMI entity as a conduit and attribute its income to the ultimate shareholders; directors and beneficial owners face CFC attribution, substantial interest penalties, and inclusion on payment-provider and correspondent-bank blacklists, which terminate the ability of the entity to use Stripe, PayPal, or any global payment rail.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing high-volume tournament entry fees and prize payouts without conducting customer due diligence (KYC), verifying beneficial owners, identifying source of funds, maintaining transaction monitoring, or filing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit as required by the Money Laundering (Prevention) Act 2001.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines of up to USD 200,000 per violation; regulatory order to cease payment processing; asset freezing orders; revocation of the corporation's ability to maintain RMI bank accounts; referral to criminal prosecution for laundering the proceeds of crime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers knowingly engaged in laundering are subject to fines of up to USD 500,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years, confiscation of personal assets, disqualification from holding directorships, and, under the RMI extradition arrangements, travel bans and extradition to foreign prosecuting jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Registry Report / Administrative Dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission of the annual report and franchise tax payment beyond the statutory grace period; failure to maintain a licensed registered agent; abandoning the RMI entity while continuing to collect esports platform revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution under Section 110 of the Business Corporations Act; the dissolved corporation loses the capacity to enter contracts, hold bank accounts, process payments, or defend proceedings; reinstatement requires all arrearages, penalties, and reinstatement fees, plus a 10% surcharge on unpaid franchise tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers remain personally liable for debts and obligations incurred after dissolution; the corporate veil fails entirely so that creditors, tournament participants, and payment providers may sue shareholders and directors directly; any bank balances escheat to the RMI government after the statutory freeze period.
